text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending installation of a stop control for northbound traffic on Windust Gate at the uncontrolled intersection of Windust Gate and Allonsius Drive, in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized a compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Windust Gate at Allonsius Drive.
